name: Nabz Lite
author: nabzbusiness

sections.description:
Nabz Lite helps WooCommerce stores understand sales, organize customers and encourage repeat purchases. The interface is designed for Persian stores and supports right-to-left layouts and Persian numerals.

Read the WordPress product page for features, edition differences and setup guidance.

Free features

  • Local sales dashboard and WooCommerce sales metrics.
  • Complete real message-send and click analytics, with date and category filters.
  • Customer search, filters, tags and RFM segmentation.
  • Cashback and a transactional customer wallet.
  • Optional order, payment, shipment and registration messages.
  • Abandoned-cart recovery with configurable delay and signed one-click cart restoration.
  • SMS login, branded login forms, custom registration fields and checkout phone verification.
  • Shipment controls with automatic, Iran Post, Tipax, courier and custom carriers and tracking codes.
  • Automatic earned, redeemed and expiring cashback notifications. Other Premium message events remain locked.
  • Local message queue, retries, operational logs and short-link click tracking.
  • WordPress privacy export, erasure and retention tools.

The local CRM, analytics, cashback and customer wallet work without a Nabz account or payment. Connecting an account is optional. If you enable message delivery, the external service charges each delivered message to the connected Nabz account wallet.

Separate Premium add-on

Nabz Premium is distributed separately. It provides smart campaigns, customer win-back, advanced automation, message attribution and messenger delivery. These executable implementations are not included in the Lite package. Lite shows the actual Premium settings interface as a preview. Paid controls are disabled, and any sample data is labelled. Cart recovery settings and all login, checkout, shipment and cashback notification settings can be saved and executed in Lite.

The separate add-on can connect store-owned accounts on supported messenger platforms, including Bale, Eitaa, Soroush Plus, WhatsApp, Telegram, Rubika and Basalam. Availability depends on the connected service and platform.

Installing or removing Premium does not disable the free Lite features. To buy Premium, sign in to your Nabz account, choose your site and create a purchase invoice. Review and pay the invoice through Zibal; the download becomes available after payment confirmation.

External service

The local sales dashboard, CRM, RFM and cashback do not require an external service. Nabz Lite contacts https://nabz.business after an administrator explicitly requests OTP sign-in or connects a Nabz account. No message is sent merely by installing the plugin.

Account sign-in sends the administrator’s mobile number to request a verification code. Verification sends that number and the entered code. The plugin stores the account session and installation connection token needed for subsequent authenticated requests. The connection identifies the current store and its WooCommerce, Lite and Premium versions.

When SMS login or checkout phone verification is enabled, a customer’s explicit request sends their mobile number to the connected service. Verification sends the challenge identifier, entered code and mobile number. The store’s existing connection token authenticates these requests; delivery uses the connected account wallet.

Connected-account operations synchronize connection status and wallet balance, retrieve server-owned message previews, create wallet top-up invoices and retrieve delivery logs. Message delivery sends the selected channel, event identifier, recipient mobile number, idempotency identifier and the minimum parameters for the event. These can include customer or store name, order number and total, payment or shipment status, tracking code and related URLs. Nabz renders the final message and passes the necessary recipient and message data to the configured delivery provider.

Wallet top-ups use a one-use handoff into the Nabz account payment flow and are bound to the store and account that requested the invoice. The plugin may make a loopback request to the same WordPress installation to run its local queue; this is not a third-party service request.

Service terms and privacy information: Nabz account legal information.
Support: Nabz support and account support tickets.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Nabz Lite from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Install and activate WooCommerce.
  3. Open the Nabz sales dashboard or Customers (CRM) screen.
  4. Run the initial RFM refresh to build the customer segmentation snapshot.
  5. If you want message delivery, open Connection and Credit and explicitly sign in to your Nabz account with the verification code.
sections.faq:
Is Nabz Lite free?

Yes. The plugin is released under GPLv2 or later. Local CRM, RFM, cashback, the customer wallet and sales analytics are free. Optional message delivery is a metered external service. Advanced marketing features are delivered by the separate Premium add-on.

Can I use it without a Nabz account?

Yes. Local analytics, segmentation, tags and the customer wallet work without an account. An account is needed for message delivery and other explicitly selected service operations.

What personal data is stored in WordPress?

Depending on enabled features, wp_options stores connection and message settings, installation/account tokens, administrator recipients and worker state. Plugin-owned tables store queued event payloads, delivery logs, derived RFM/customer snapshots, recoverable cart contents, short-link clicks and cashback transactions. Customer tags and configured registration fields are stored in user metadata. WooCommerce order metadata stores cashback and shipment references. The first short-link click may include an IP address and user agent.

Operational logs older than 90 days are removed. Personal identifiers on old short-link records are anonymized after 90 days. Completed or stopped jobs older than 365 days are removed. WordPress privacy export and erasure cover matching derived customer records. Source WooCommerce orders and records already processed by the external service follow their own lifecycle and are not deleted by those callbacks.

The store administrator chooses which events send messages and is responsible for the necessary recipient consent or other lawful basis. Lite does not automatically add a marketing-consent form or claim to keep consent evidence.

How does cashback work?

Cashback is store credit earned after a successful purchase and usable on a later purchase. The administrator selects the percentage and expiration period; 0 means no expiration. Eligible value is the discounted product total, excluding shipping and arbitrary fees. Credit already spent does not earn more cashback.

Only registered customers earn or spend wallet credit. Failed or cancelled reservations are released. Partial or full refunds proportionally restore spent credit and reverse the earned cashback. The wallet and storefront displays are free. Automatic SMS cashback notifications are included in Lite; sending uses the connected Nabz account wallet.

Why are Premium pages visible?

They show the settings interface of the separately distributed product. You can browse tabs and explanations. Paid actions remain locked, and sample data is labelled. Login, checkout verification, cart recovery, shipment controls and cashback notifications are free executable features. The Lite ZIP contains no executable implementation of the remaining Premium features.

What happens when I delete the plugin?

The uninstaller removes Nabz-specific tables, options and metadata. It does not delete source WooCommerce orders, core WordPress records or data already retained by the external service. Deactivation alone does not erase Nabz data.

Which assets are bundled?

Peyda font assets provide Persian typography and digit rendering. The source tree also includes Vazirmatn under SIL Open Font License 1.1. Admin icons are based on Feather Icons under the MIT License. Calendar conversion uses parts of jalaali-js under the MIT License. Bundled open-source license texts accompany those assets.

Where can I get help?

Use Nabz support for setup and technical help, and submit an account support ticket for purchase, account or privacy requests. The Persian user guide remains available on the Nabz website.
sections.changelog:
1.5.0

  • Move abandoned-cart recovery, SMS login and checkout verification, shipment controls and automatic cashback notifications into Lite.
  • Preserve existing settings, wallets, tracking codes and cart reminders while upgrading.
  • Keep advanced automation, smart campaigns, messenger delivery and win-back locked without Premium.

1.4.7

  • Show real message-send and click analytics in Lite, with every category selected by default.
  • Enable offline login previews and transient login-method, display-mode and login-box choices; keep paid saving and execution locked.

1.4.6

  • Show the complete 35-event message catalogue while keeping Premium controls and forged submissions locked.
  • Preview the real Premium settings screens with disabled controls and clearly labelled sample data.
  • Link Premium purchase controls to the Nabz WordPress product page.
  • Add administrator recipients with a plus button on the last row, without a permanent empty input.
  • Confirm deletion and wallet-credit removal in an accessible modal, with cancellation, keyboard focus and protection against repeated clicks.
  • Start wallet top-up presets at 100,000 tomans. Preserve existing settings and records without a new database migration.

1.4.5

  • Prepare the WordPress.org release with English directory documentation while retaining the original Persian readme in source documentation.
  • Escape the wallet top-up icon using the existing restricted SVG allowlist.

1.4.4

  • Unify Peyda typography across plugin screens, wallets, dialogs and notifications, including Persian digit rendering.

1.4.3

  • Track SMS short-link clicks in the store while preserving the original destination and retry-stable links.
  • Distinguish real sends from failed or simulated sends and preserve existing data during migration.

1.4.2

  • Update account connection, six-digit verification, Persian notifications and dialogs.
  • Support custom wallet top-ups and improve message, messenger and account-gated screens.

1.4.1

  • Synchronize wallet and account balances from one authoritative amount.
  • Bind top-up invoices and payment handoffs to the requesting site and account.

1.4.0

  • Connect accounts through OTP sign-in and simplify access for the separately activated Premium add-on.

1.3.6

  • Keep the BusinessAccount bootstrap dependency in the Lite package to prevent activation and upgrade failures.

1.3.5

  • Count successful SMS sends consistently and show expired Premium license status.

1.3.4

  • Preserve canonical login and payment handoff destinations when proxies normalize routes.

1.3.3

  • Restore the previous page after login or registration and reject external redirect destinations.

1.3.2

  • Align the package and text domain with the official nabz-lite slug and strengthen contextual output escaping.

1.3.1

  • Use correctly enqueued static admin assets, strengthen validation and preserve data while migrating legacy prefixes.

1.3.0

  • Separate the free GPL Lite implementation from the Premium runtime, add privacy tools and free transactional cashback.

1.1.13

  • Add automatic, postal, Tipax, courier and custom shipment methods and tracking details.

1.1.12

  • Consolidate account fields and OTP registration with WooCommerce checkout.

1.1.11

  • Allow login enforcement at order submission, cart entry or checkout entry.

1.1.10

  • Simplify message, messenger and campaign administration.

1.1.9

  • Fail closed when messenger connection or routing is unavailable and clarify delivery limits.

1.1.8

  • Add centralized messenger connections, local platform logos and account-based routing.

1.1.7

  • Improve adaptive RFM scoring, tie handling and refund-aware monetary values.

1.1.6

  • Preserve final SMS text, provider identifiers and actual delivery costs in logs.

1.1.5

  • Improve custom registration fields and metadata compatibility.

1.1.4

  • Add targeted campaigns, CSV recipients, reusable templates and improved registration-field editing; strengthen OTP rate limits and support PHP 7.4.

1.1.3

  • Improve queue throughput, worker locking and one-minute scheduling.

1.1.2

  • Support optional and required custom registration fields with server-side validation.

1.1.1

  • Normalize each order’s stored currency before RFM calculation and backfill existing snapshots.

1.1.0

  • Add shipment tracking, campaign audiences, custom registration fields and the Nabzak admin assistant.

1.0.2

  • Improve OTP checkout, registration options, login branding and discount-code copying.

1.0.1

  • Add contextual help links and reproducible validated release packaging.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
